_about: W02 privacy canaries (BM-09, FR-16, CLAUDE.md §6). Fake sensitive strings that a leaking template or builder would print. tools/check_output.sh passes every `value` to infra/scripts/privacy-lint.py as --canary. tests/test_render.py plants each one into a copy of batch_sample.json at `plant.path` (`expect`: render refuses the record, or coarsens the pin so the value never appears) and injects each `value` into a copy of the template (the lint must then fail with `rule`). The 6-dp pin is the one batch_sample.json already carries for lot 1, so every clean build is linted against it; its latitude and longitude are separate canaries because a lone 6-dp number is invisible to the regex rules.
